'''Moheed''' was a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as crew chief of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] ''[[Shadow Raptor]]''.
